metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2026 · Neagley
metas.description: Neagley, drawing from her experience with Jack Reacher and the 110 Special Investigators, embarks on a perilous mission to expose a sinister threat, risking her life to unravel the mystery.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2026 · Lanterns
metas.description: Lanterns follows new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, two intergalactic cops drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · Spider-Noir
metas.description: Ben Reilly, a seasoned, down-on-his-luck private investigator in 1930s New York, is forced to grapple with his past life, following a deeply personal tragedy, as the city's one and only superhero.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2026 · Man on Fire
metas.description: Follows John Creasy, a wounded former mercenary on a quest to get revenge for the loss of his only companion while defending the daughter of his dead colleague from the forces that tore her family apart.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2026 · Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord
metas.description: After the Clone Wars, Maul plots to rebuild his criminal syndicate on a planet untouched by the Empire.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2026 · The Madison
metas.description: A New York family's life unravels after a tragedy; they process their grief while vacationing in rural Montana, where they explore human connection amid their profound sorrow.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · Marshals
metas.description: Ex-Navy SEAL Kayce Dutton leaves the Yellowstone ranch to work with an elite U.S. Marshals team.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2026 · Wonder Man
metas.description: Small-time actor Simon Williams struggles to reckon with his personal life while hiding his super-powers as he tries to land his dream role. Meanwhile, a shady government agent leverages a new friendship in order to save his own job.

metas.name: ★ 4.6 · 2026 · Star Trek: Starfleet Academy
metas.description: Young cadets train to become Starfleet officers as they deal with friendships, rivalries, and romance, all while facing a mysterious threat to both the Academy and the Federation.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · Ride or Die
metas.description: Two best friends, Judith and Debbie, discover Judith is secretly an assassin. After a hit goes wrong, they go on the run while being targeted by a mysterious enemy, forcing them to confront the secrets between them.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2025 · Spartacus: House of Ashur
metas.description: In a world where he survived the events of Spartacus (2010), Ashur clawed his way to power, owning the same ludus that once owned him. Allying with a fierce gladiatrix, Ashur ignites a new kind of spectacle that offends the elite.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2025 · The Mighty Nein
metas.description: Follows a group of criminals and misfits who are the only ones that can prevent the kingdom from plunging into chaos when an arcane artifact capable of reshaping reality falls into the wrong hands.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2025 · The Last Frontier
metas.description: Follows Frank Remnick, a U.S. Marshal in charge of the quiet and weathered barrens of Alaska, as he needs to deal with a prison transport plane crash full of violent inmates inside his jurisdiction.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · Marvel Zombies
metas.description: After the Avengers are overtaken by a zombie plague, a group of survivors discover the key to bringing an end to the super-powered undead, racing across a dystopian landscape and risking their lives to save their world.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · The Terminal List: Dark Wolf
metas.description: Navy SEAL Ben Edwards' abrupt discharge from the military lands him a new job working with a mysterious CIA operative. As he delves deeper into the world of covert intelligence he struggles with the moral gray areas of clandestine...

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2025 · Eyes of Wakanda
metas.description: Wakandan warriors who, throughout history, have traveled the world to retrieve dangerous vibranium artifacts.

metas.name: ★ 4.5 · 2025 · Ironheart
metas.description: Genius teenage inventor Riri Williams creates the most advanced suit of armor since Iron Man.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · Murderbot
metas.description: A security android struggles with emotions and free will while balancing dangerous missions and desire for isolation, evading detection of its self-hacking as it finds its place.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2025 · Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld
metas.description: Follows the galaxy's criminal underworld. Asajj Ventress, a former assassin, flees with a new ally, while Cad Bane confronts his past when meeting an old friend turned Marshal.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Devil May Cry
metas.description: When a mysterious villain threatens to open the gates of Hell, a devilishly handsome demon hunter could be the world's best hope for salvation.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · The Bondsman
metas.description: Resurrected bounty hunter Hub Halloran gets an unexpected second chance at life, love and his nearly forgotten musical career--only to find that his old job now has a demonic new twist.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2025 · Daredevil: Born Again
metas.description: Matt Murdock finds himself on a collision course with Wilson Fisk when their past identities begin to emerge.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
metas.description: Peter Parker is on his way to becoming a hero, but his path to get there is anything but ordinary.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2025 · Paradise
metas.description: A Secret Service agent investigates the murder of a former president in a seemingly peaceful community.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2025 · Prime Target
metas.description: A post-graduate mathematics student discovers an effort being made to destroy his work in finding a pattern in prime numbers that would allow him to access every computer in the world.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2025 · The Hunting Party
metas.description: Follows a team who are assembled to track down and capture the most dangerous killers, all of whom have just escaped from a top-secret prison that's not supposed to exist.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2025 · American Primeval
metas.description: It follows the gritty and adventurous exploration of the birth of the American West, the violent collisions of cults, religion, and men and women fighting for control of the new world.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · On Call
metas.description: Follows a pair of police officers on patrol as they respond to a new radio call, arriving on the scene to resolve incidents.
